translations.web: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
translations.bsb: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
translations.kjv: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
translations.asv: And over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of a firmament, like the terrible crystal to look upon, stretched forth over their heads above.
